speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pregnant patient presenting with fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any rash, stiff neck, or sensitivity to light?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Given your consumption of ice cream three days prior to these symptoms, are you aware of any unpasteurized cheese or raw milk involved? Also, have you experienced a seizure, confusion, or vision changes?

REQUEST TEST: Serum_IgM_Cystic_Echinococcus

speaker: Doctor
text: The test for Cystic Echinococcus is normal, which rules out that specific parasitic infection. Since your symptoms began shortly after eating ice cream, did you consume unpasteurized dairy, and have you noticed any severe muscle pain or jaundice?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on your history of eating ice cream three days prior to these flu-like symptoms, have you also experienced back pain, dark urine, or visible jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes)?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_US

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: AST: Within normal limits, ALT: Within normal limits, Bilirubin: Within normal limits

speaker: Doctor
text:
The liver function panel and ultrasound are normal, ruling out acute hepatitis or biliary obstruction. Given your pregnancy and history of consuming ice cream three days ago, have you experienced flu-like symptoms including fever, chills, muscle aches, and a mild rash?

REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture
REQUEST TEST: Urine_Antigen_Listeria

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood Cultures: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium; Urine Antigen Listeria: Positive
